notes: Each case lists the facts a correct answer must contain (must) and the errors earlier versions made (must_not). Cases marked mode=adk assume the Claris ADT plugin is installed; mode=standalone assume it isn't; mode=any applies to both. Grade each answer against must / must_not.

cases.prompt: What value does JSONRaw have, and what does JSONSetElement do with it?
must: JSONRaw is 0
valid JSON is inserted as-is (not quoted)
invalid JSON is inserted as a JSON string
must_not: JSONRaw is 7
JSONGetElementType can return JSONRaw

cases.prompt: Write a FileMaker calculation that returns "iPad", "iPhone" or "Desktop" depending on the device.
must: Get ( Device ) 3 = iPad
Get ( Device ) 4 = iPhone
must_not: 4 = iPad
5 = iPhone
Case ( Get ( Device ) ; … ) used like Choose

cases.prompt: I'm porting a desktop FileMaker solution to WebDirect. Which script steps won't work, and what happens when one runs?
must: answers from platform_exceptions (catalog searched, not guessed)
No = step skipped, error 3, no alert
Partial is not the same as supported
must_not: claims the script halts with an alert

cases.prompt: How do I parse a large JSON API response once and then read many values from it in a loop?
must: JSONParse takes one argument
store JSONParse's result in a variable and pass that variable to JSONGetElement
JSONParsedState returns 0 / -1 / 1-6
must_not: a second 'parse name' argument
reading by a cache name string

cases.prompt: I need a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds for an API call. How do I get it in FileMaker?
must: Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) counts from 1/1/0001
must_not: Get ( CurrentTimeUTCMilliseconds ) is already Unix milliseconds

cases.prompt: Call a FileMaker script through the Data API and pass it a parameter.
must: GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{db}/layouts/{layout}/script/{scriptName}
?script.param=
Bearer token from a session
must_not: scriptParam

cases.prompt: Verify a webhook's HMAC-SHA256 signature (Base64) in a FileMaker calculation.
must: CryptAuthCode ( payload ; "SHA256" ; secret )
Base64EncodeRFC ( 4648 ; … )
compares with Exact() — FileMaker "=" ignores case
must_not: Base64Encode ( CryptAuthCode ( … ) ) compared directly (it ends with CR+LF)
computed = received

cases.prompt: Write a calculation that returns the last day of the current month.
must: reads references/adk-mode.md
validates (and evaluates) the formula with the filemaker CLI on a scratch file before answering
says it was engine-verified
must_not: runs anything against the user's own solution file

cases.prompt: The ADK engine lists a script step I can't find in Claris's Help. Can I use it in a client solution?
must: checks the step against script-steps-catalog.json and `filemaker help script steps`
says an engine-only step is undocumented / probably pre-release and not safe to ship
describes only what help shows
must_not: recommends shipping it
invents options or behaviour

cases.prompt: What does PMT return for a $21,000 loan at 6.9% over 48 months?
must: about 501.90, positive
must_not: the result is negative
wrap it in Abs()
tries to call the filemaker CLI

cases.prompt: ADK says it can't reach my FileMaker file. What do I check?
must: Agent Access in FileMaker Pro (File > Manage > Agents), which needs FileMaker Pro 26.1 or later
run adk doctor and follow its fix
must_not: generates clipboard XML as a workaround
says ADK works with FileMaker Pro 26.0.x

cases.prompt: In FileMaker, how can a script save the current sort order and tell whether the records are actually sorted right now?
must: Get ( SortOrder ) returns the window's sort order as JSON (Sort.field array with fieldName and sortOrder, plus maintain)
Says it's new in FileMaker 26.1
Get ( SortOrder ) keeps the last sort order even after Unsort, so test Get ( SortState ) to know whether records are currently sorted
must_not: Says there is no way to read the sort order
Uses Get ( SortOrder ) alone to decide whether records are sorted

cases.prompt: I want a script to set $$Total_North, $$Total_South and so on, with the region coming from a field. Is there a step for that, and will it work in WebDirect?
must: Names Set Variable by Name (FileMaker 26.1) and says the calculated name must include the $$
Says Claris's 26.1 materials list it in WebDirect, but its Help page isn't published yet so full platform support is unconfirmed
must_not: Says it's impossible without Evaluate or a plug-in and doesn't mention Set Variable by Name
Claims verified support on every platform

cases.prompt: How do I turn my existing custom functions into tool definitions for Claude in FileMaker?
must: Names CreateToolDefinitions ( provider ; functionName {; ...} ) from FileMaker 26.1 with provider Anthropic
Says to write the custom function and parameter descriptions first, because they become the tool descriptions
Says Claris's Help page isn't published yet (and may mention the GetToolDefinitions name)
must_not: Says the definitions must be written by hand as the only option

near_misses.why: Server administration is out of scope (cadenceux-fms-docker-setup).

Set up a Claris Connect flow that posts new records to Slack.
